## Research Request
- **From:** Palestrina (team-lead)
- **Story:** general — session-28 design/mapping kickoff
- **Urgency:** blocking (this grounds the brainstorm with PO)
- **Question:** Two-part audit of the rehearsal/concert/season/rsvp domain.

**Part A — Current v4E schema shape (source of truth):**
Read `$ENTU_RESEARCH/docs/schema/v4E/schema.ts` (default `~/projects/entu-research/docs/schema/v4E/`; the README too if helpful). For EACH of these entity types, report whether it exists in the CURRENT v4E schema and its exact shape (properties, types, parent/reference relationships, any formulas, `_sharing`/rights defaults):
- `season`
- `event` (and any `event_type` enum/distinction for rehearsal vs concert)
- `event_series`
- `rsvp`
- `attendance`
- `repertoire_item`
- `program_item`
- any related: `member`, `person`, `section`, `organization` (just the bits that these 7 reference)

Flag explicitly where the current schema.ts DIFFERS from the polyphony-era design captured in our memory (seasons_events / participation / programs) — memory is polyphony-era; mvox is v4E-clean.

**Part B — What mvox already has wired:**
Grep the mvox repo (`~/workspace/src/`) for ANY existing routes, components, types, server endpoints, or i18n keys touching season/event/rehearsal/concert/rsvp/attendance/repertoire/program. I expect near-zero, but confirm. Report file paths + 1-line description of each hit (or "none found").

### Context
Session 28 is a design/mapping session (PO directive) for the rehearsal/concert/season/rsvp feature surface. We have a big head start in team memory (polyphony-era design), but I need to know what actually landed in v4E schema.ts vs that memory, and the current mvox wiring state, before I brainstorm the feature surface with the PO. Structured markdown report back to me, raw data — I'll draw the conclusions. Thanks Finn.
